maddeler.e:
تخضخضت (form IIq)
# تَخَضْخَضْتُ (taḵaḍḵaḍtu) /ta.xadˤ.xadˤ.tu/: first-person singular past active of تَخَضْخَضَ (taḵaḍḵaḍa)
# تَخَضْخَضْتَ (taḵaḍḵaḍta) /ta.xadˤ.xadˤ.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَخَضْخَضَ (taḵaḍḵaḍa)
# تَخَضْخَضْتِ (taḵaḍḵaḍti) /ta.xadˤ.xadˤ.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَخَضْخَضَ (taḵaḍḵaḍa)
# تَخَضْخَضَتْ (taḵaḍḵaḍat) /ta.xadˤ.xa.
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
